V1.lesson: Established the first leakage-safe architecture replay baseline, but V2 improved probability quality and discrimination on the same strict window.

V2.lesson: Best same-window accuracy, ROC-AUC, log loss, Brier score, and overall probability objective among the four controlled model versions.

V3.lesson: Aggressive feature-family selection plus stacking did not generalize to 2025-2026 and underperformed V2.

V4.lesson: Player-first/roster-oriented challenger did not solve the recent-season regime shift. Paired bootstrap P(V4 better than V2)=0.259.

final_decision: Freeze V2; no V5 without genuinely new authoritative data.
